text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:

- Opinion polls show president Lennart Meri is the person of the year in 1996; Estonians and Russians separately prefer respectively decathlon athlete Erkki Nool and the Centre Party leader Edgar Savisaar.
- The year of 1996 was successful and Estonia continued on its current course in foreign, internal and economic policies, Prime Minister Tiit Vahi said.
- Conflict between the two Russian parties in the parliament resulted in the disslution of the Russian faction.
- The government prolonged residence permits of 1.900 retired Russian officers and their family members for two years.
- Israeli Ambassador Oded Ben-Hur opened a photo exhibition in Tallinn, dedicated to the 3000th anniversary of Jerusalem.
- Museum of the Estonian blue-black-white national flag was opened at Otepaa.
